stem: The report highlights the ____ of renewable energy in reducing national carbon emissions over the next decade.
explain_zh: the 後面又接 of，空格要放名詞，所以選 significance（重要性）。significant 是形容詞、significantly 是副詞、signifying 是動名詞，都不能被 the 修飾。記住字尾 -ance/-ence 通常是名詞。

stem: Good lecturers can ____ complex theories for beginners without leaving out the details that really matter.
explain_zh: can 後面要接原形動詞，simplify（簡化）才是動詞。simple 是形容詞、simplicity 是名詞、simply 是副詞。記住字尾 -ify 多半是動詞，例如 clarify、justify。

stem: The new regulations are designed to ____ consumer protection in fast-growing online shopping markets.
explain_zh: to 後面接原形動詞，strengthen（加強）是動詞形。strength 是名詞、strong 是形容詞、strongly 是副詞。記住字尾 -en 常把形容詞變成動詞，例如 widen、shorten。

stem: Scientists have questioned the ____ of data that was collected from a single very small sample.
explain_zh: the ... of 中間必須是名詞，所以選 reliability（可靠性）。reliable 是形容詞、reliably 是副詞、rely 是動詞。記住 rely 動詞 → reliable 形容詞 → reliability 名詞這一串變化。

stem: Readers may easily ____ a chart when the axes carry no labels and the units are missing.
explain_zh: may 後面接原形動詞，misinterpret（誤解、誤讀）符合「沒有標示就會看錯」的語意。interpretation 是名詞、interpreter 是口譯員、interpretive 是形容詞。記住字首 mis- 表示「錯誤地」。

stem: People tend to ____ their ability to concentrate after a sleepless night, and then make careless mistakes.
explain_zh: tend to 後面要接原形動詞，overestimate（高估）才正確。overestimation 與 estimation 都是名詞，overestimating 是動名詞，都不能接在 to 後面。記住字首 over- 表示「過度」。

stem: Relying on cheap imported water is clearly ____ in the long term, especially as the population grows.
explain_zh: be 動詞後面接形容詞當主詞補語，unsustainable（無法持續的）才對。unsustainably 是副詞、sustainability 是名詞、sustain 是動詞。記住 un- 表否定、-able 表「可以…的」。

stem: Every year the company publishes a detailed report on its ____ performance and its progress towards net zero.
explain_zh: 空格要修飾名詞 performance，必須用形容詞 environmental（環境的）。environment 是名詞、environmentally 是副詞、environmentalist 是環保人士。記住字尾 -al 常把名詞變形容詞。

stem: Air quality in the city improved ____ after older diesel vehicles were banned from the downtown area.
explain_zh: 空格修飾動詞 improved，要用副詞 dramatically（大幅地）。dramatic 是形容詞、drama 是名詞、dramatize 是動詞。記住形容詞加 -ly 變副詞。

stem: Under the ____ of a new principal, the school raised its graduation rate by almost twenty per cent.
explain_zh: under the ____ of 是固定用法，中間要放抽象名詞 leadership（領導）。leader 是「領導人」，under the leader of 不通；leading 是形容詞、lead 是動詞。記住字尾 -ship 表示身分或狀態。

stem: Patients with rare conditions are usually referred to a ____ at a larger teaching hospital in the capital.
explain_zh: a 後面要接名詞，指「專科醫師」用 specialist。special 是形容詞、specialise 是動詞、specially 是副詞。記住字尾 -ist 表示「從事某專業的人」。

stem: International ____ is essential if plastic pollution in the oceans is ever going to be reduced.
explain_zh: 空格是句子的主詞，要用名詞 cooperation（合作）。cooperate 是動詞、cooperative 是形容詞、cooperatively 是副詞。記住字首 co- 表示「共同」。

stem: The examiner deleted the whole paragraph because the information in it was completely ____ to the question.
explain_zh: be 動詞後接形容詞，且語意是「不相關的」，所以選 irrelevant。relevance 是名詞、relevantly 是副詞；unrelevant 是常見的拼錯，relevant 的否定字首是 ir- 不是 un-。

stem: Heating an entire office building all night long is extremely ____ and adds a great deal to running costs.
explain_zh: and 後面接形容詞 costly，所以空格也要用形容詞 inefficient（沒有效率的）。inefficiency 是名詞、efficiently 是副詞；unefficient 不是英文字，efficient 的否定要用 in-。

stem: Passing the national exam at fifteen was a remarkable ____ for a student who had taught himself at home.
explain_zh: a remarkable 後面要接名詞，achievement（成就）才對。achieve 是動詞、achievable 是形容詞、achieving 是動名詞。記住字尾 -ment 是名詞，例如 development、improvement。

stem: Her main ____ to the project was designing the questionnaire that all the interviewers later used.
explain_zh: 所有格 Her 加形容詞 main 之後要接名詞，指「貢獻」用 contribution。contribute 是動詞、contributing 是動名詞；contributor 是「貢獻的人」，但這裡講的是她做的事而不是她本人。

stem: The council finally agreed to ____ its decision after local residents presented a great deal of new evidence.
explain_zh: to 後面接原形動詞，且語意是「重新考慮」，選 reconsider。consideration 是名詞、considerable 是「相當多的」、considerate 是「體貼的」。記住字首 re- 表示「再一次」。

stem: A ____ learning environment encourages students to ask questions instead of hiding their difficulties.
explain_zh: 空格修飾名詞 environment，要用形容詞 supportive（給予支持的）。support 是動詞或名詞、supporter 是支持者、supportively 是副詞。記住字尾 -ive 多為形容詞。

stem: Doctors warn that excessive screen time just before bed can be ____ to the quality of teenagers' sleep.
explain_zh: be 動詞後接形容詞，語意是「有害的」，所以選 harmful。harm 是名詞或動詞、harmfully 是副詞；harmless 是「無害的」，意思正好相反。記住 -ful 有、-less 沒有。

stem: The transport ministry plans to ____ the entire railway network within the next ten to fifteen years.
explain_zh: to 後面接原形動詞，modernise（現代化、汰舊換新）是動詞。modern 是形容詞、modernisation 是名詞、modernly 幾乎不用。記住字尾 -ise/-ize 把形容詞變成動詞。

stem: Younger consumers show a clear ____ to buy second-hand clothing rather than brand-new items every season.
explain_zh: a tendency to + 原形動詞是固定用法，表示「有…的傾向」。habit、tradition、custom 雖然也和行為有關，但後面不能直接接 to buy 這種不定詞結構。記住 have a tendency to do something。

stem: Rising sea levels are a direct ____ of the steady warming of the world's oceans over the past century.
explain_zh: 海平面上升是海洋暖化造成的「結果」，所以用 consequence。reason 是原因，方向相反；purpose 是目的、condition 是條件，都不合。記住 a consequence of = …的後果。

stem: The whole argument rests on the ____ that consumers always behave rationally when they compare prices.
explain_zh: 論點「建立在」尚未證實的前提上，這種前提叫 assumption（假設）。conclusion 是推論之後才得到的結論、permission 是許可、definition 是定義。記住 rest on the assumption that…。

stem: Students who set their own learning goals usually show much stronger ____ throughout a long course.
explain_zh: 持續學習的「動力」是 motivation。intention 是一時的打算、attention 是注意力、invention 是發明，都不是持續努力的驅動力。記住 strong motivation = 強烈的學習動機。

stem: Interviewing farmers gave the research team a completely different ____ on the causes of water shortages.
explain_zh: 看事情的「角度、觀點」是 perspective，常說 a different perspective on something。dimension 是面向或尺寸、direction 是方向、tendency 是傾向，都無法搭配 on the causes。

stem: Reducing household waste has become the city government's top ____ for the coming financial year.
explain_zh: top priority 是固定搭配，指「最優先的事」。preference 是個人偏好、importance 是重要性但不說 top importance、advantage 是優勢。記住 give priority to something。

stem: Voters are demanding far greater ____ in the way that political donations are collected and spent.
explain_zh: 要求公開、可受檢驗，用 transparency（透明度）。visibility 指看得見的程度，多用於物理視線；secrecy 是保密，意思相反；formality 是形式或正式性。記住 financial transparency。

stem: Communities that rebuilt their homes within a year of the flood showed remarkable ____ and determination.
explain_zh: 遭遇災難後能快速復原的能力是 resilience（韌性、復原力）。resistance 是抵抗、reluctance 是不情願、dependence 是依賴，都不符合「重建得很快」的語意。

stem: The report examines income ____, which has widened in most developed countries since the early 1990s.
explain_zh: 差距「擴大」講的是不平等，用 inequality。equality 是平等，意思相反；quantity 是數量、quality 是品質，都與貧富差距無關。記住 in- 是否定字首。

stem: The city library greatly improved the ____ of its older buildings by installing ramps, lifts and wider doors.
explain_zh: 裝斜坡和電梯是為了讓行動不便者能進出，這叫 accessibility（無障礙程度）。access 是名詞但不說 the access of its buildings；availability 是「有沒有可取得」、ability 是個人能力。

stem: Publishing false figures in a leading journal completely destroyed the young scientist's ____ within the field.
explain_zh: 造假被拆穿，失去的是別人對他的「可信度」credibility。creativity 是創造力、capability 是能力、curiosity 是好奇心，都不是造假直接毀掉的東西。

stem: Protecting the ____ of native plant species is one of the central aims of the new national park.
explain_zh: 保護「物種多樣性」用 diversity，常見詞組 biodiversity。density 是密度、quantity 是數量、majority 是多數，都無法表達種類豐富這個概念。

stem: Foreign investors tend to value long-term economic ____ far more highly than short-term profit.
explain_zh: 投資人重視的是經濟「穩定」，所以用 stability。standard 是標準、strength 是力量、status 是地位，都不能表達不大起大落的意思。記住 stable 形容詞 → stability 名詞。

stem: The redesigned engine burns much less fuel, which represents a clear gain in ____ rather than in speed.
explain_zh: 用更少燃料做同樣的事，就是「效率」提升，用 efficiency。urgency 是急迫性、frequency 是頻率、sufficiency 是足夠的量，都不對。四個字都是 -ency 結尾，要靠字根分辨。

stem: Teachers at the school were given much greater ____ to design their own lessons and choose their own materials.
explain_zh: 可以自己決定怎麼教，就是有 autonomy（自主權）。dependence 是依賴、obedience 是服從，兩者都與自主相反；discipline 是紀律或學科。記住 professional autonomy。

stem: Long-term ____ from every member state will be needed if the emissions target is to be met by 2050.
explain_zh: 長期投入、持續遵守承諾用 commitment。intention 只是打算、attention 是注意力、prevention 是預防，都撐不起 long-term 這個修飾。記住 a commitment to doing something。

stem: Good science teaching begins with genuine ____ about the world rather than with the memorisation of facts.
explain_zh: 和「背誦事實」相對的是想探索、想問為什麼，也就是 curiosity（好奇心）。accuracy 是準確度、obedience 是服從、certainty 是確定性，都不是探索的起點。

stem: Long-term ____ to traffic noise has been linked to higher stress levels and poorer sleep in city residents.
explain_zh: 長期「暴露」在噪音中用 exposure to something。expansion 是擴張、expression 是表達；experience 後面要接 of 而不是 to，搭配也不對。記住 exposure to pollution。

stem: Building a tunnel under the bay is technically ____, but the cost would be far beyond the current budget.
explain_zh: 技術上「可行的」是 feasible。flexible 是有彈性的、favourable 是有利的、fashionable 是流行的，都無法和 technically 搭配表達「做得到」。記住 technically feasible、economically feasible。

stem: The government has published a ____ review covering every department of the national health service.
explain_zh: covering every department 表示範圍全面，用 comprehensive（全面的）。competitive 是有競爭力的、comparative 是比較的、compulsory 是義務的。記住 a comprehensive review = 全面檢討。

stem: Charging tourists an entry fee for the old town remains a highly ____ policy among local business owners.
explain_zh: 有人贊成有人反對，就是 controversial（有爭議的）。convenient 是方便的、confidential 是機密的、conventional 是傳統的，都無法解釋 among local business owners 的分歧。

stem: The sample of forty students was simply not ____ to support such a broad conclusion about the whole country.
explain_zh: 樣本數不夠多，用 sufficient（足夠的）。efficient 是有效率的、deficient 是缺乏的（意思相反但搭配是 deficient in）、proficient 是精通的。四個字長得像，要看字根 suffic- 表示「足夠」。

stem: Early diagnosis is absolutely ____ if the treatment is to have any real chance of succeeding.
explain_zh: 關係到治療能不能成功，所以是 crucial（關鍵的）。casual 是隨性的、cautious 是謹慎的、curious 是好奇的，都不能表示「非常重要」。記住 crucial = extremely important。

stem: The findings of this experiment were entirely ____ with those reported in three earlier studies.
explain_zh: be consistent with 是固定搭配，表示「與…一致」。constant 是持續不變的、persistent 是固執或持續的、resistant 是有抵抗力的，後面都不接 with 表達一致。

stem: The examiner crossed out two sentences that were clearly not ____ to the main argument of the essay.
explain_zh: be relevant to 表示「與…相關」，符合被劃掉的理由。reliable 是可靠的、reluctant 是不情願的、remarkable 是驚人的，都不能搭配 to the main argument。

stem: Some loss of biodiversity now appears ____, even if every country meets its current climate targets.
explain_zh: 就算努力也躲不掉，是 inevitable（不可避免的）。invaluable 是「極其寶貴的」、invisible 是看不見的、incredible 是難以置信的。注意 in- 在 invaluable 裡不是否定。

stem: Mobile payment has become ____ in Taiwan, and is now accepted even in small traditional markets.
explain_zh: 描述某種做法「普遍存在」用形容詞 widespread。widened 與 broadened 是過去分詞，指被加寬；spreading 是正在擴散的動作，都不能表達「已經很普及」的狀態。

stem: Moderate daily exercise is ____ to both physical health and long-term mental well-being.
explain_zh: be beneficial to 表示「對…有益」，用在健康最自然。profitable 指賺錢、favourable 指條件有利、generous 指慷慨，都不能形容運動對健康的好處。

stem: Within a month it became ____ that the original construction timetable had been far too ambitious.
explain_zh: it became apparent that… 是常見句型，表示「後來變得明顯」。appealing 是吸引人的、applicable 是適用的、appropriate 是適當的，放進 it became…that 都講不通。

stem: These are only ____ findings; the complete data set will not be released until the end of June.
explain_zh: 完整資料還沒出來，現在的只是「初步的」結果，用 preliminary。permanent 是永久的、predictable 是可預測的、persuasive 是有說服力的，都無法對比後半句的 complete data。

stem: The survey question was so ____ that different participants understood it in completely different ways.
explain_zh: 同一句話被理解成不同意思，代表題目 ambiguous（語意不清的）。anonymous 是匿名的、ambitious 是有企圖心的、abundant 是豐富的，都解釋不了理解不一致。

stem: There are two ____ approaches to solving urban traffic problems, and they rarely work well together.
explain_zh: two distinct approaches 表示兩種明顯不同、界線分明的做法。distinguished 是傑出的、distant 是遙遠的、distracted 是分心的，都與「彼此不同」無關。

stem: Wikipedia is convenient for a quick check, but it is not always a ____ source for an academic essay.
explain_zh: 學術寫作要求資料來源可信，用 a reliable source。readable 是易讀的、respectable 是體面的、responsible 是負責任的，都不能形容資料的可信度。

stem: The restoration of the temple required a ____ amount of both public money and specialist labour.
explain_zh: a considerable amount of 表示「相當大量的」。considerate 是體貼的、conservative 是保守的、consequent 是隨之而來的，都不能修飾 amount。注意 considerable 與 considerate 只差字尾。

stem: Climate change is a ____ problem that no single government can possibly solve on its own.
explain_zh: 牽涉很多因素、難以處理的問題是 complex（複雜的）。complete 是完整的、compliant 是順從或合規的、compulsive 是強迫性的，都不符合後半句「沒有國家能單獨解決」。

stem: Low-lying coastal villages are especially ____ to flooding as global sea levels continue to rise.
explain_zh: be vulnerable to 表示「易受…傷害」，是雅思環境題的高頻用法。valuable 是有價值的、variable 是多變的、voluntary 是自願的，後面都不接 to flooding。

stem: Buying rice and cooking oil in bulk is far more ____ for a large family than shopping every single day.
explain_zh: economical 指「省錢的、划算的」，用來形容做法；economic 指「經濟上的」，例如 economic growth。economy 是名詞、economics 是經濟學。兩個形容詞長得像但意思差很多。

stem: Long-term noise pollution can seriously ____ children's ability to concentrate in the classroom.
explain_zh: 這裡需要動詞「影響」，用 affect。effect 通常是名詞「影響、效果」，當動詞時是「造成、實現」；effort 是努力；afflict 用於疾病折磨，搭配太重。記住 affect 動詞、effect 名詞。

stem: The signing of the peace treaty in 1998 was widely regarded as a ____ moment for the whole region.
explain_zh: historic 指「具有歷史意義的、重大的」；historical 只是「與歷史有關的」，例如 historical documents。history 是名詞、historian 是歷史學家。這題強調事件的重要性，所以用 historic。

stem: The freezer used in the experiment needs a ____ power supply, because even a one-second cut ruins the samples.
explain_zh: continuous 指「中間完全不中斷」，符合「斷一秒就毀了」。continual 指「一再重複但中間有停頓」；occasional 是偶爾的、temporary 是暫時的，都相反。

stem: Only a small ____ of students in the department chose to spend a whole year studying abroad.
explain_zh: students 是可數名詞複數，要用 a small number of。amount、quantity 和 a great deal 都用於不可數名詞，例如 a small amount of money。記住 number 配可數、amount 配不可數。

stem: At the start of the lecture the professor ____ the audience that the deadline had been extended by a week.
explain_zh: tell 後面可以直接接人再接 that 子句，所以用 told the audience that…。say 不能直接接人，要說 said to the audience；speak 和 talk 要接 to。這是台灣學生最常錯的地方。

stem: The department will ____ each student a tablet computer for the whole duration of the design course.
explain_zh: 從擁有者的角度「借出去」用 lend somebody something。borrow 是「借進來」，方向相反；rent 是付費租用；owe 是欠。記住 lend out、borrow from。

stem: House prices in the area have ____ sharply since the new underground station opened two years ago.
explain_zh: rise 是不及物動詞，指「自己上升」，完成式是 have risen。raise 是及物動詞，後面一定要有受詞；arise 指問題發生；arouse 指引起情緒。記住 prices rise，people raise prices。

stem: The minister ____ to comment on the report, saying only that an investigation was still going on.
explain_zh: refuse to do something 表示「拒絕去做某事」。deny 是「否認」，後面接名詞或動名詞；reject 是拒絕接受某個提案、後面接名詞；resist 是抵抗。只有 refuse 能直接接不定詞。

stem: Regular maintenance can ____ small mechanical faults from developing into extremely expensive failures.
explain_zh: prevent something from doing 是固定句型，表示「防止…發生」。avoid 後面直接接動名詞，不接 from；protect 要用 protect A from B，但保護的對象不是「故障」；refuse 不合語意。

stem: Could you please ____ me to send the questionnaire to all the participants before Friday afternoon?
explain_zh: remind somebody to do something 是「提醒某人去做某事」。remember 是自己記得，不能說 remember me to send；memorise 是背下來；recall 是回想。記住 remind 有「提醒別人」的意思。

stem: The unusually heavy rain last week ____ serious delays on almost every line of the northern railway.
explain_zh: cause 後面直接接名詞，表示「造成（不好的結果）」。make 要用 make something happen 或 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞；let 是允許；take 不能表示造成。記住 cause delays、cause damage。

stem: Three passengers were slightly ____ when the driver of the bus braked suddenly on the wet road.
explain_zh: 人受傷用 injured；damaged 和 broken 用在物品損壞；harmed 偏抽象的傷害，不用在交通事故的外傷。記住 injure people、damage things。

stem: The museum charges every adult visitor an entrance ____ of two hundred dollars at the main gate.
explain_zh: 為了進入或使用服務而付的錢叫 fee，例如 entrance fee、tuition fee。price 是商品的定價、cost 是成本、salary 是薪水，都不能和 entrance 搭配。

stem: Over the past fifteen years she has built a highly successful ____ in environmental journalism.
explain_zh: career 指長期累積的「職業生涯」，才能用 build 和 fifteen years 修飾。job 是一份具體工作、work 是不可數的工作內容、labour 是勞動力。記住 build a career。

stem: Checking every figure twice ____ that the final report contains no arithmetical mistakes at all.
explain_zh: ensure that… 表示「確保某事發生」。assure 是向「某人」保證，後面要接人；insure 是投保；reassure 是安撫別人的情緒。記住 ensure + that 子句。

stem: Schools that moved online had to ____ their teaching methods to suit students with very different home conditions.
explain_zh: adapt 是「調整、使適應」，常說 adapt something to something。adopt 是「採用、收養」，指整套拿來用而不是修改；adept 是形容詞「熟練的」；adhere 是遵守，要接 to。

stem: She turned down the offer on ____, even though accepting it would have doubled her monthly salary.
explain_zh: on principle 是固定用法，表示「基於原則」。principal 是「校長」或形容詞「主要的」，拼字只差一個字母；discipline 是紀律或學科；standard 是標準。

stem: In a formal research report, the informal word 'kids' should be replaced by ____ when you describe the participants.
explain_zh: 學術寫作要用中性、正式的 children。guys、folks 是口語；teens 是縮短的口語形式，正式寫作要寫 teenagers 或 adolescents。記住考官看到 kids 會扣正式度分數。

stem: In an academic essay you should write ____ participants instead of the very informal phrase 'loads of participants'.
explain_zh: a considerable number of 是正式書面語，適合描述樣本數。tons of、heaps of、a whole bunch of 都是誇張的口語表達，在雅思寫作裡會被視為不夠正式。

stem: In a scientific paper, researchers usually write that they ____ better results rather than saying they 'got' them.
explain_zh: obtain 是 get 的正式對應字，常說 obtain results、obtain permission。grab、pick up、land 都是口語，語氣太隨便，不適合實驗報告。

stem: A formal report would describe the situation as ____ rather than calling it 'a really big headache'.
explain_zh: a major issue 是中性正式的說法。a huge hassle、a big deal、a real pain 都是日常口語，帶有情緒色彩，在學術寫作裡應該避免。

stem: In academic writing, the informal expression 'find out the cause' is normally written as ____ the cause.
explain_zh: determine 是正式用語，常見於論文的方法段落。figure out、work out、dig up 都是口語片語動詞，雅思寫作 Task 2 建議換成單一動詞的正式字。

stem: Formal essays avoid contractions, so the word don't in your draft should be rewritten as ____ throughout.
explain_zh: 正式寫作要把縮寫還原，don't 的完整形式是 do not。don not 和 do nt 都不是英文；does not 是第三人稱單數，主詞不同不能亂換。

stem: In a formal email to the admissions office you should ____ further information rather than simply 'ask for' it.
explain_zh: request 是正式的書面用語，適合寫給機構的電子郵件。beg for 太卑微、chase up 和 nag about 都是口語，語氣不得體。

stem: In an official document, staff who help visitors with paperwork are said to ____ them with their applications.
explain_zh: assist 是 help 的正式對應字，常用於公文與報告。give a hand to 是口語、back up 偏支持或備份、sort out 是很隨意的英式口語。

stem: In the literature review, writers ____ previous studies instead of saying that they 'talk about' them.
explain_zh: discuss 是學術寫作中談論文獻的標準動詞，後面直接接受詞。chat about 和 go on about 是口語，bring up 是片語動詞，都不適合文獻回顧。

stem: An official policy document would say that the ministry will ____ a new programme, not that it will 'kick one off'.
explain_zh: initiate 是正式的「啟動、發起」，常見於政府文件。kick off 和 get going on 都是口語；start up 多指開創公司或啟動機器，語氣也偏輕鬆。

stem: The contract states that either party may ____ the agreement by giving one month written notice.
explain_zh: 法律文件用 terminate 表示「終止」。call off 是取消活動、wrap up 是收尾、drop 是放棄，都是口語說法，不會出現在合約裡。

stem: Customers who ____ the product through the official website receive a two-year warranty at no extra charge.
explain_zh: purchase 是 buy 的正式用語，適合商業與學術文件。grab、snap up、pick up 都是口語，帶有隨手拿、搶購的語氣。

stem: Formal notices usually state that applicants are ____ to submit two references, rather than saying they 'have to'.
explain_zh: be required to do something 是正式規定的說法。be needed 指「被需要」，主詞應該是東西；be supposed to 語氣較弱且偏口語；be wanted to 不是正確結構。

stem: After the inspection the committee judged the existing safety measures to be ____ for a building of this size.
explain_zh: adequate 是正式的「足夠、達到標準」，適合檢查報告。okay、alright、fine 都是口語評價，寫進正式文件會顯得不專業。

stem: When describing the graph, formal writing prefers ____ to informal expressions such as 'a massive jump'.
explain_zh: a sharp increase 是雅思 Task 1 描述數據的標準用語。a huge leap、a big spike、a massive climb 都太口語或太誇張，不適合客觀描述圖表。

stem: In a formal essay you should write an important ____ rather than using the vague word 'thing' in your topic sentence.
explain_zh: factor 是正式且具體的名詞，指影響結果的因素。thingy、stuff、bit 都是模糊的口語字，雅思寫作評分會因為用字不精確而扣分。

stem: The research team ____ a survey of two thousand commuters in order to measure changes in travel habits.
explain_zh: carry out a survey 是「執行、進行調查」的固定說法，雅思寫作常用。carry on 是繼續、be carried away 是得意忘形、carry over 是延續到下一期，都不能接 a survey。

stem: The new recycling law ____ a significant change in the way ordinary households sort their rubbish.
explain_zh: bring about 表示「帶來、造成（改變）」，後面常接 change。bring up 是提出話題或養育、bring off 是成功辦到、bring back 是帶回或恢復，語意都不合。

stem: The design team will have to ____ a workable solution before the research funding runs out in March.
explain_zh: come up with 是「想出（辦法、點子）」。come across 是偶然遇到、come up to 是走近或達到標準、come round to 是漸漸接受某個看法，都不是「想出解決方案」。

stem: Residents living close to the airport have had to ____ aircraft noise for more than three decades.
explain_zh: put up with 是「忍受」。put off 是延期、put down to 是歸因於、put away 是收起來，都無法表達長期忍耐噪音的意思。

stem: The university committee has promised to ____ the complaints that were raised by international students.
explain_zh: look into 是「調查、深入了解」，常和 complaint、case 搭配。look after 是照顧、look up to 是敬佩、look out for 是留意提防，都不是調查。

stem: With the help of a private donation, the university plans to ____ a new centre for climate research.
explain_zh: set up 是「設立、成立（機構）」。set off 是出發或引爆、set aside 是撥出或擱置、set back 是延誤，都不能用來成立研究中心。

stem: Small firms are often reluctant to ____ extra staff during a period of economic uncertainty.
explain_zh: take on 有「僱用、承擔」的意思，take on staff 就是增聘員工。take off 是起飛或脫下、take over 是接管、take in 是吸收或收留，都不是僱用。

stem: Negotiations between the two sides finally ____ when neither party was willing to make any concession.
explain_zh: break down 用在談判、機器、系統上表示「失敗、崩潰」。break out 是爆發（戰爭、疾病）、break in 是闖入、break through 是突破，都與談判破裂不同。

stem: Economists are still trying to ____ exactly why the recovery slowed down so quickly last winter.
explain_zh: figure out 是「弄清楚、想通」，後面可接 why 子句。figure in 是被列入考量、make up 是編造或組成、turn out 是結果證明，都不能表示研究原因。

stem: In her review of the article, Professor Wang ____ that the sample had been drawn from only one city.
explain_zh: point out that… 是「指出（某個事實）」，後面可接 that 子句。point at 是用手指著、point to 後面要接名詞當作證據、point up 較少見且不接 that 子句。

stem: Doctors said they could not yet ____ the possibility of a second infection in the same patient.
explain_zh: rule out 是「排除（可能性）」，是學術與新聞常見用法。rule over 是統治、rule off 是畫線隔開、rule up 幾乎不用，都不合。

stem: Nutritionists usually advise their patients to ____ processed meat and sugary drinks rather than give them up completely.
explain_zh: cut down on 是「減少（攝取量）」，正好和後面的 give up completely 形成對比。cut off 是切斷、cut up 是切碎、cut in on 是打斷插話。

stem: Several parents ____ the issue of school lunch quality during the question session at the meeting.
explain_zh: bring up 是「提出（話題、議題）」。bring down 是使下降或推翻、bring along 是帶著一起來、bring round 是使人清醒或說服，都不是提出議題。

stem: The immigration department is badly understaffed and simply cannot ____ so many applications each month.
explain_zh: deal with 是「處理」。deal in 是買賣某類商品、deal out 是分發、deal to 不是標準用法。記住 deal with a problem、deal with complaints。

stem: The city council is trying to ____ the illegal advertising boards that block the pavement near the station.
explain_zh: get rid of 是「除掉、清除」。get over 是克服或從病中康復、get through 是通過或完成、get on with 是相處融洽或繼續做，都不是清除物品。

stem: Two of the candidates ____ detailed plans for reducing traffic in the historic centre of the city.
explain_zh: put forward 是「提出（計畫、建議）」，是正式寫作常用的片語動詞。put down 是放下或記下、put aside 是擱置、put off 是延期，都不合。

stem: A much larger airline is expected to ____ the loss-making regional carrier before the end of June.
explain_zh: take over 是「接管、併購」公司。take after 是長得像長輩、take up 是開始從事某項活動、take back 是收回，都不能表達併購。

stem: The environmental report ____ much stricter controls on the use of single-use plastic packaging.
explain_zh: call for 是「呼籲、要求」，常見於報告與新聞。call off 是取消、call up 是打電話或徵召、call in 是請人來處理，都不合語意。

stem: Experts warn that several major coastal cities may ____ fresh water within the next twenty years.
explain_zh: run out of 是「用完、耗盡」。run into 是偶遇或撞上、run over 是輾過或快速複習、run through 是快速看過一遍，都不是資源耗盡。

stem: She finally ____ the scholarship because the course content did not match her research interests.
explain_zh: turn down 是「拒絕（提議、獎學金）」。turn up 是出現或調高音量、turn over 是翻面或營業額、turn out 是結果證明，都不是拒絕。

stem: Many older employees say they struggle to ____ the rapid changes in workplace technology.
explain_zh: keep up with 是「跟上（速度、變化）」。keep off 是遠離、keep back 是保留或退後、keep down 是壓低，都不能表示跟上進度。

stem: Renewable sources now ____ almost a third of the electricity generated in the country every year.
explain_zh: account for 在數據描述中是「占（比例）」，雅思 Task 1 很常用。count on 是依賴、allow for 是把某因素考慮進去、stand for 是代表或縮寫。

stem: In the final chapter she ____ interviews with twelve local farmers to support her main argument.
explain_zh: draw on 是「運用、援引（資料、經驗）」，學術寫作高頻用法。draw in 是吸引進來、draw out 是拉長或使人開口、draw back 是退縮。

stem: Always ____ the claims in your essay with data taken from a reliable and recent source.
explain_zh: back up 是「支持、佐證」，back up a claim with data 是寫作常用搭配。back down 是讓步、back off 是退開、back out 是臨陣退出。

stem: The committee will ____ a final decision only after it has reviewed all of the written evidence.
explain_zh: 英文固定說 make a decision，中文的「做決定」不能直譯成 do a decision。give a decision 與 put a decision 都不是搭配。記住 make 用在 decision、mistake、progress。

stem: The minister refused to ____ responsibility for the failure of the flood prevention scheme.
explain_zh: responsibility 要搭配 take，take responsibility for 就是「為…負責」。make responsibility、do responsibility 都不存在；give responsibility 是「賦予某人責任」，主詞與語意都不合。

stem: Candidates should ____ close attention to the exact wording of every question in the writing task.
explain_zh: attention 的固定搭配動詞是 pay，pay close attention to 是「密切注意」。say attention、do attention、make attention 都是中式英文，意思看得懂但搭配是錯的。

stem: The campaign is designed to ____ awareness of mental health problems among senior high school students.
explain_zh: raise awareness 是固定搭配，raise 是及物動詞，後面可以直接接 awareness。rise 和 arise 都是不及物動詞不能接受詞；lift 多指實際把東西舉起來。

stem: Local volunteers ____ a key role in the clean-up operation that followed the typhoon last September.
explain_zh: role 的搭配動詞是 play，play a key role in 是「在…扮演重要角色」。act a role 只用在戲劇表演、take a role 較少見且語氣不同、do a role 不是英文搭配。

stem: Researchers have shown that air pollution ____ a serious impact on the lung development of young children.
explain_zh: impact 搭配 have，have an impact on 是「對…有影響」。make an impact 雖然存在，但指「令人印象深刻」，和後面的 serious 與 on children 語氣不合；do 和 give 都不能搭配 impact。

stem: The design team worked through the weekend in order to ____ the deadline set by the client.
explain_zh: deadline 的固定搭配是 meet a deadline，表示「趕上期限」。catch 用在趕車、arrive 是不及物動詞、follow a deadline 不是英文說法。

stem: It is far too early to ____ any firm conclusions from such a small and unrepresentative sample.
explain_zh: conclusion 搭配 draw，draw a conclusion 是「下結論」。take a conclusion、do a conclusion 都不是搭配；pull 雖然也有拉的意思，但不能和 conclusion 連用。

stem: Rising sea levels ____ a serious threat to the survival of many low-lying island communities.
explain_zh: threat 的正式搭配動詞是 pose，pose a threat to 是「對…構成威脅」。put a threat、do a threat 不是英文；offer a threat 語氣相反，offer 帶有提供好處的意思。

stem: Only members of staff who have registered may ____ access to the confidential patient database.
explain_zh: access 搭配 gain 或 have，gain access to 是「取得使用權限」。reach access、win access、catch access 都不是英文搭配，雖然這幾個動詞都有「得到」的影子。

stem: The laboratory has ____ research into antibiotic resistance for more than fifteen years.
explain_zh: research 的正式搭配動詞是 conduct，conduct research into 是「對…進行研究」。make research、take research、build research 都是錯誤搭配，中文的「做研究」不能用 make。

stem: After eight months of difficult talks, the two governments finally ____ an agreement on fishing rights.
explain_zh: agreement 搭配 reach，reach an agreement 是「達成協議」。arrive 後面要加 at 才能接受詞；gain an agreement 與 found an agreement 都不是搭配。

stem: The government must ____ urgent measures to reduce the amount of food wasted by supermarkets.
explain_zh: measures 的搭配動詞是 take，take measures to 是「採取措施」。make measures、do measures、hold measures 都不是英文搭配。可以一起記 take action、take steps。

stem: Successful language learners usually ____ realistic goals for themselves at the start of every week.
explain_zh: goal 的搭配動詞是 set，set goals 是「設定目標」。put goals、place goals、build goals 都不是搭配。可以一起記 set a target、set a deadline。

stem: Most people find it extremely hard to ____ the habit of checking their phone late at night.
explain_zh: habit 的搭配動詞是 break，break a habit 是「戒掉習慣」。destroy、cut、damage 雖然都有破壞的意思，但不能和 habit 連用。相對的說法是 form a habit。

stem: According to the physiotherapist, the patient has ____ remarkable progress since the operation in May.
explain_zh: progress 的固定搭配是 make progress。do progress、take progress、give progress 都是常見的中式錯誤。記住 make 家族：make progress、make an effort、make a difference。

stem: Unfortunately the economic model does not ____ into account regional differences in average income.
explain_zh: take something into account 是「把…列入考量」的固定用法。make into account、bring into account、put into account 都不是英文，雖然三個動詞的意思看起來也很接近。

stem: The revised syllabus ____ far greater emphasis on speaking skills than the version it replaces.
explain_zh: emphasis 的搭配動詞是 place 或 put，place emphasis on 是「著重於」。make emphasis、do emphasis、hold emphasis 都不是搭配。

stem: Parents living near the school have repeatedly ____ concerns about the safety of the pedestrian crossing.
explain_zh: concern 搭配 raise，raise concerns about 是「提出疑慮」。rise 是不及物動詞、lift 指實際舉起、grow concerns 不是標準搭配。注意 raise 與 rise 的差別。

stem: The photography exhibition ____ considerable attention from both local visitors and the international media.
explain_zh: attention 可以搭配 attract 或 draw，attract attention 是「吸引注意」。pull attention、collect attention、gather attention 都不是英文搭配。

stem: All applicants must ____ the entry requirements of the department before they are invited to an interview.
explain_zh: requirement 的搭配動詞是 meet 或 satisfy，meet the requirements 是「符合要求」。fill、answer、obey 雖然都有回應規定的味道，但都不能和 requirements 連用。

stem: More than three hundred senior high school students ____ part in the environmental survey last spring.
explain_zh: take part in 是「參加」的固定說法。make part、do part、play part 都不是搭配；play a part in 雖然存在，但意思是「起作用」而且一定要有冠詞 a。

stem: Consumers will eventually ____ the price for the environmental damage caused by cheap fast fashion.
explain_zh: pay the price for 是「為…付出代價」的固定搭配。spend 的受詞是金錢或時間、cost 的主詞是物品、buy the price 不是英文。

stem: Policymakers must ____ a balance between economic growth and the conservation of natural habitats.
explain_zh: balance 的搭配動詞是 strike，strike a balance between A and B 是「在兩者之間取得平衡」。hit、beat 都有打擊的意思但不能搭配 balance；make a balance 也不是英文。

stem: Sales of electric scooters rose steadily in Asia last year; ____, they fell sharply in most European markets.
explain_zh: 前後兩句方向相反，要用表示對比的 in contrast。for instance 是舉例、in addition 是補充、as a result 是因果，都不能連接相反的趨勢。

stem: The largest factory in the town closed down last year; ____, local unemployment almost doubled within six months.
explain_zh: 工廠關閉是原因、失業率上升是結果，要用 as a result。for instance 舉例、in contrast 對比、in particular 強調特定項目，都無法表達因果。

stem: Certain subjects, ____ mathematics and music, appear to require a great deal of daily practice.
explain_zh: 後面接的 mathematics and music 是前面 certain subjects 的例子，所以用 for instance。as a result 是結果、in contrast 是對比、in conclusion 用在文章收尾。

stem: The two schools are very similar ____ class size, but they differ greatly in their teaching methods.
explain_zh: in terms of 表示「就…方面而言」，用來指出比較的層面。in case of 是萬一、in spite of 是儘管、in view of 是鑑於，放進來語意都不通。

stem: ____ the proposed budget cuts, the committee has agreed to publish its final decision next Friday.
explain_zh: with regard to 是正式書信與報告常用的「關於」。In regard for 是錯誤形式，正確是 in regard to；on behalf of 是代表某人；by means of 是藉由某種方法。

stem: The theory is ____ correct, but it largely ignores cultural differences between the countries being compared.
explain_zh: to some extent 表示「在某種程度上」，正好搭配後面的轉折 but。at some point 指時間點、for some reason 是不知為何、by some means 是用某種方法。

stem: The available evidence is still very limited; ____, the trend identified in the study is worth investigating.
explain_zh: 前句說證據不足、後句仍肯定價值，屬於讓步轉折，用 nevertheless。therefore 是因此、moreover 是而且、meanwhile 是同時，都不是轉折。

stem: The sample was far too small, and the results of the experiment are ____ rather unreliable.
explain_zh: 樣本太小導致結果不可靠，是因果關係，用 therefore。however 是轉折、otherwise 是否則、whereas 用來對比兩個子句，都不合。

stem: The plan will cut carbon emissions by a quarter. ____, it will create several thousand jobs in rural areas.
explain_zh: 兩句都是這個計畫的好處，屬於補充，用 In addition。In contrast 是對比、Instead 是取而代之、Otherwise 是否則，都不能用來累加優點。

stem: Online courses are considerably cheaper than campus courses; ____, they offer far less personal support.
explain_zh: 前面講優點、後面講缺點，用 on the other hand 表示另一面。in the same way 是同樣地、as a result 與 for this reason 都是因果，語意都不對。

stem: ____, the evidence reviewed above suggests that early intervention saves both money and lives.
explain_zh: 句子在總結前面所有證據，所以用 In conclusion。In contrast 是對比、For instance 是舉例、In terms of 是就某方面而言，都不能用來收尾。

stem: Urban households recycle their waste regularly, ____ many rural households still have no collection service.
explain_zh: whereas 是連接詞，用來對比兩個子句的差異。therefore 和 hence 表示因果、moreover 表示補充，而且這三個都是副詞，不能直接連接兩個子句。
